name: vike-txiki-adapter
description: Adapter agnóstico para servir um build de produção do Vike no runtime txiki.js (tjs), 100% WinterTC.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile dist/index.mjs --target=node --packages external && bun build src/cli.ts --outfile dist/cli.mjs --target=node --packages external && bun build src/vite.ts --outfile dist/vite.mjs --target=node --packages external && chmod +x dist/cli.mjs && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly
